criteria.name: Identity and source-backed footprint
findings: Manifest identity resolves to Neil Armstrong Hall and Purdue GIS feature 642; the supplied source set is building-specific.
The R11 changes correctly retain the coarse NDHM envelopes only as reference meshes and hide them from viewport display and rendering.

Architectural wall/roof correspondence to the GIS polygon remains unresolved; prior screening shows material footprint/roof-slab overlap differences and the new revision did not change footprint geometry.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale
findings: The saved AssetRoot is at the local origin with identity world transform.

The master Placement_neil_armstrong_hall marker was reopened read-only at [-109.0, 400.1893310546875, 0.0], zero rotation, unit scale; it instances Asset_neil_armstrong_hall from the expected library path and exactly matches the manifest origin.
Marker alignment verifies placement origin only; the building shell's orientation and wall-level GIS registration remain approximate/unverified.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
findings: The 53 ft atrium ceiling and current four-level description have primary-source support in the prior source package.

The distinctive warped, wing-like cantilever roof is still not represented with verified dimensions or a calibrated roof plan; orthophoto roof colors do not establish construction materials or roof boundaries.
R11 changes no roof geometry and does not resolve the main roof-shape deduction.

criteria.name: Facade, entrance, and distinctive architecture
findings: The `ARMS_Sea_Wolf_ACM` canopy material now reads dark red-brown in the R11 entry render, consistent with the attributed 2016 Wikimedia exterior photo; the photo is perspective/un-calibrated, so the exact shader color is an estimate.
The facade broadly combines brick, curtain glazing, and canopy massing, but window cadence, roof-wing profile, and facade-to-photo registration remain generic or unverified.
Hiding coarse reference solids removes visual clutter but does not add architectural geometry.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and evidence
findings: Blender 5.2.3 reopened the exact asset hash; scene and export collection are present with 445 objects, 415 meshes, and 23 materials.
All listed manifest object names match the 445 objects in the exported collection; no unlisted or missing names were found.
All mesh objects have valid material assignments; no external image dependencies or missing image paths were found.
A deterministic mesh-vertex/polygon/world-transform digest matches the prior `.blend1` snapshot; object names also match. R11 changes are presentation visibility and canopy material only.
The evidence is detailed, though the presentation set does not yet show a calibrated whole-building comparison or verified architectural footprint.

r11_change_assessment.score_change_from_r10: +0.2: the facade presentation is cleaner and the canopy hue is better supported; major geometry/evidence deductions remain.
